name: ResponsePulsar
author: thelogiclad

sections.description:
ResponsePulsar is an intelligent AI-powered response assistant and lead automation engine for WordPress forms.

Research shows that responding to an inbound customer lead within 5 minutes increases conversion rates by 8x. Standard confirmation auto-responders (“Thank you for your submission”) are generic and fail to answer specific customer questions.

ResponsePulsar connects your WordPress forms directly to cutting-edge AI models (Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT, and Anthropic Claude), reads your website pages and services to build a local context knowledge base, filters out spam bots, and generates draft replies ready for review in your WordPress dashboard.

Upgrade to Pro

🚀 Key Features (Free Version)

  • Instant Form Interception: Seamlessly captures submissions from popular form builders:
    • Contact Form 7
    • WPForms
    • Elementor Pro Forms
    • Gravity Forms
    • Ninja Forms
  • Multi-Provider AI Engine: Connect your own API key with support for:
    • Google Gemini (Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Flash, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Custom)
    • OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, GPT-3.5-Turbo, Custom)
    • Anthropic Claude (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3 Haiku, Custom)
  • Intelligent Website Knowledge Base: Automatically scans your published pages and posts into a local database index to feed accurate business details to the AI.
  • Lead Inbox & Review Station: View leads, inspect AI draft replies, and edit responses before clicking “Send Email”.
  • One-Click Tone Adjuster: Dynamically re-draft replies inside the editor with a single click:
    • 👔 Professional (Formal & authoritative)
    • 😊 Friendly (Warm & conversational)
    • ⚡ Shorten (Concise 1-2 sentence core message)
    • 📅 Request Meeting (Adds consultation scheduling CTA)
  • AI Confidence Assessment: Every draft includes a 0-100% confidence rating and a detailed explanation of why the AI generated the response.
  • Sentiment & Intent Classification: Automatically labels leads with intent (sales, support, refund, general) and mood (positive, neutral, frustrated).
  • High-Speed Spam Filtering: Automatically screens bot messages, SEO pitches, and phishing submissions before generating drafts.
  • Custom Business Rules & Guardrails: Define custom negotiation boundaries, discount limits (e.g. “Max 10% discount on packages”), and booking links.
  • Reports & Analytics: Track weekly inquiry volume, spam blocked percentages, and average response times with a visual 7-day trend chart.
  • API Rate Limiting Protection: Built-in safeguard prevents spam flood attacks from exhausting your AI credits (caps automated calls at 30/hour).

💎 ResponsePulsar Pro (Available on Website)

Need fully autonomous operations or eCommerce integration? Upgrade to ResponsePulsar Pro:

  • ⚡ Fully Automated Mode: Hands-free auto-send for replies exceeding your chosen confidence threshold (50% to 95%).
  • 🛒 WooCommerce Product Sync: Ingests product catalogs, pricing, variation specs, stock levels, and store FAQs.
  • 📬 Bidirectional Email Reply Tracking: Synchronize client email responses back into your WordPress lead timeline via IMAP Polling or Inbound Webhooks.
  • 💬 Multi-Turn Conversation Threads: Manage ongoing customer negotiations directly from the WordPress Admin.

👉 Learn More & Get ResponsePulsar Pro

🔒 Privacy & Third-Party AI Services Disclosure

ResponsePulsar connects to external third-party Large Language Model (LLM) APIs to generate automated responses and classify spam. By entering your API key in the settings, the plugin communicates with your chosen provider:

  1. Google Gemini API (Google LLC)

    • Service Used: Generative Language API (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com)
    • Data Sent: Lead message, lead name (if provided), and relevant website context snippets.
    • Google Privacy Policy | Google Terms of Service | Gemini API Additional Terms

  2. OpenAI API (OpenAI, LLC)

    • Service Used: Chat Completions API (https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions)
    • Data Sent: Lead message, lead name (if provided), and relevant website context snippets.
    • OpenAI Privacy Policy | OpenAI Terms of Use

  3. Anthropic API (Anthropic, PBC)

    • Service Used: Messages API (https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages)
    • Data Sent: Lead message, lead name (if provided), and relevant website context snippets.
    • Anthropic Privacy Policy | Anthropic Terms of Service

Note: No telemetry, analytics, or user tracking data is sent to ResponsePulsar or any external servers. Communication only occurs with your configured AI provider using your own API credentials.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Search for ResponsePulsar or upload the responsepulsar.zip file.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to the new ResponsePulsar menu in your admin sidebar.
  5. Go to the Settings tab:
    • Select your preferred AI Provider (Google Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic).
    • Enter your API Key.
    • Choose your model and define any custom business rules.
  6. Click Save Settings.
  7. Go to the Knowledge Base tab and click Scan Website to index your published pages and posts.
  8. Submissions from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor, Gravity Forms, or Ninja Forms will now automatically appear in your Lead Inbox with AI drafts ready for review!
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key to use this plugin?

Yes. You can use your own free or paid API key from Google Gemini (Google AI Studio), OpenAI, or Anthropic. Google Gemini offers a generous free tier for developers.

Which form plugins are supported?

ResponsePulsar supports Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Pro Forms, Gravity Forms, and Ninja Forms out of the box with zero configuration required.

Does ResponsePulsar email leads automatically?

In the Free version, the plugin operates in Draft & Approve mode. When a form is submitted, the AI creates a draft in your WordPress Lead Inbox. You can review, edit, change the tone, and click “Send Email” when ready. Fully automated hands-free auto-sending is available in ResponsePulsar Pro.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

The free version scans public WordPress pages, posts, and custom fields. WooCommerce product catalog scanning (including pricing, availability, and attributes) is available in ResponsePulsar Pro.

Will spam submissions drain my API credits?

No. The plugin includes a built-in spam evaluator and a strict rate limiter (max 30 AI submissions/hour) to protect your API limits and budget.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fixed settings form submission issue caused by hidden IMAP input validation.
  • Added novalidate attribute to configuration form and hardened AJAX settings save handler.

1.0.0

  • Initial official release of ResponsePulsar.
  • Added form integrations for Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, Gravity Forms, and Ninja Forms.
  • Added support for Google Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic Claude LLM providers.
  • Added pure PHP website database crawler for building local business context.
  • Added One-Click Tone Adjuster (Professional, Friendly, Condensed, Meeting CTA).
  • Added AI Confidence Assessment and Sentiment/Intent classification.
  • Added Reports & Analytics dashboard with CSS weekly trend charts.
  • Added API Rate Limiter and spam shield protection.
